tools.name: mware_find_customer
tools.description: Find a mware customer by case-insensitive name substring. Returns matching customers with their UUID id, externalId (CID), and display name. Backed by GET /api/customers (admin-only) with client-side filtering since the upstream API has no name search. Increase `limit` if you need more matches.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the customer name

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default 20, max 100)

tools.name: mware_get_user_config
tools.description: Fetch the configuration entries for a single mware user (rate limits, enabled products, billing codes, pricing). Backed by GET /api/users/{user_id}/config (admin-only).

tools.name: mware_request_logs
tools.description: Query mware request logs (page 0, size 40, sorted by createdAt DESC — i.e. always the most recent results). All filters are optional; combine them to narrow down. `customer_code` and `customer_name` both go through the upstream `composite` substring search, so only one is sent (customer_code wins if both are given). Backed by GET /api/users/logs/all (admin-only).

applicant.description: Substring match on the applicant name on the request

customer_code.description: Customer external id / CID — substring-matched via the composite search

customer_name.description: Customer name — substring-matched via the composite search (ignored if customer_code is set)

tools.name: mware_get_retention
tools.description: Fetch the stored request/response payloads for a single request log id — raw upstream request, raw upstream response, headers, and CRS standard-format request/response. Backed by GET /api/users/retention/{id}.

request_log_id.description: UUID of the request log entry

tools.name: mware_get_billing
tools.description: Aggregated billing for a date range. Returns grand totals, per-customer rollups (sorted desc by net amount), and per-(product, type, description) rollups. Backed by GET /api/billing/total (newer pricing engine, computes amounts from per-config pricing). Both dates are ISO-8601 instants (e.g. "2026-05-01T00:00:00Z"). One `product` value can cover several distinct offerings that differ by `type` / `description` (e.g. "Criminal and Eviction" splits into type `C` / description "Criminal Request" vs type `E` / description "Eviction Request"). Use `description` or `type` to narrow to a single sub-product before rolling up.

start_day.description: Inclusive start of the billing window (ISO-8601 instant)

end_day.description: Inclusive end of the billing window (ISO-8601 instant)

product.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on the entry's product field. Applied before rollups so `by_customer` becomes the list of customers who used the product. Example: "Bridger Insight" matches "LexisNexis Bridger Insight Search". Entries with a null product are skipped when this is set.

description.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on the entry's description field. Use this to separate sub-products that share a product name. Example: product "Criminal and Eviction" bundles two descriptions — pass `description: "criminal"` to count only Criminal Requests, or `description: "eviction"` for Eviction Requests. Entries with a null description are skipped when this is set.

type.description: Optional exact (case-insensitive) match on the entry's short type code (e.g. "C" for Criminal, "E" for Eviction). Use when you already know the code; prefer `description` for human-readable filtering. Entries with a null type are skipped when this is set.

tools.name: mware_pxe_offersiq_list_rulesets
tools.description: List OffersIQ rulesets (always PXE productId 3 — this server manages only OffersIQ, not other PXE products like LeadIQ), optionally filtered to one customer (owner userId) and/or a name substring. Returns id, name, owner, active version, and a human-readable summary of the active rules. Backed by GET /api/pxe/rulesets (admin-only; userId filtering is client-side).

customer_id.description: Customer/user UUID — only rulesets owned by this user

name_filter.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the ruleset name

tools.name: mware_pxe_offersiq_get_ruleset
tools.description: Fetch one OffersIQ ruleset by ID: metadata, owner, the active version's definition (raw JSON plus human-readable rule lines), and optionally the full version history. Rejects rulesets belonging to other PXE products (only OffersIQ, productId 3, is managed). Backed by GET /api/pxe/rulesets/{id} (admin-only).

include_versions.description: Include every version with its definition (default false: only the active definition)

tools.name: mware_pxe_offersiq_create_ruleset
tools.description:
Create a new OffersIQ ruleset, optionally owned by a specific customer. Always created under the OffersIQ product (PXE productId 3, JSON_MEMORY engine) — other PXE products are not supported. The definition is validated locally before the request; validation errors abort, unknown-attribute warnings are returned alongside the created ruleset. Note: creating a ruleset does NOT wire it to a customer config — use mware_pxe_offersiq_assign_ruleset for that. Backed by POST /api/pxe/rulesets (admin-only).

Ruleset definition: a flat list of nodes forming a tree via zero-based "parent" indices (a parent must be a group node appearing EARLIER in the list; root nodes use parent=null).

Node shapes:
- Group: {"type":"group","operator":"AND"|"OR","parent":null|<index>,"negated":false}
- Condition: {"type":"condition","attribute":"<attribute>","operator":"<operator>","value":<value>,"parent":<index>,"negated":false}

Condition operators: EQUALS, NOT_EQUALS, GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN, GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUALS, LESS_THAN_OR_EQUALS, IN, NOT_IN, BETWEEN, IS_NULL, IS_NOT_NULL, WITHIN_LAST_DAYS, WITHIN_LAST_MONTHS, WITHIN_LAST_YEARS, OLDER_THAN_DAYS, OLDER_THAN_MONTHS, OLDER_THAN_YEARS.
- IS_NULL / IS_NOT_NULL take no value.
- IN / NOT_IN take an array value.
- BETWEEN takes a two-element array [min, max].
- WITHIN_LAST_* / OLDER_THAN_* take a number (JSON-memory engine only).

At the root level everything must pass (ALL_MUST_PASS) for APPROVED; inside a group, conditions combine with the group's AND/OR operator.

Known attributes (camelCase; booleans compared with EQUALS true/false; monthsSinceMostRecent* are absent when nothing is on file): creditScore, totalAccountCount, openAccountCount, openInstallmentAccountCount, openRevolvingAccountCount, openOtherAccountCount, inquiryCount, availableCredit, totalOpenBalance, unsecuredCreditCardBalance, unsecuredDebtBalance, medicalTypeBalance, studentLoanBalance, educationLoanBalance, govSecuredLoanBalance, chargeAccountBalance, noteLoanBalance, visaCardBalance, mastercardCardBalance, discoverCardBalance, amexCardBalance, delinquentAccountCount, derogatoryAccountCount, delinquencyPast12MonthCount, onTimePaymentPercentage, openMortgageDelinquency, openAutoDelinquency, totalCollectionCount, totalCollectionAmount, nonMedicalThirdPartyCollectionCount, repossessionCount, foreclosureCount, publicRecordCount, publicRecordBankruptcyCount, taxLienCount, openBankruptcyPast24Months, closedBankruptcyPast24Months, monthsSinceMostRecentPublicRecord, totalScheduledMonthlyPayment, autoHighCredit, autoUtilization, openToBuyExcludingInstallmentsAndMortgages, monthsSinceMostRecentInquiry.

Example — approve when score >= 620 and no bankruptcies:
{"nodes":[{"type":"group","operator":"AND","parent":null,"negated":false},{"type":"condition","attribute":"creditScore","operator":"GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUALS","value":620,"parent":0,"negated":false},{"type":"condition","attribute":"publicRecordBankruptcyCount","operator":"EQUALS","value":0,"parent":0,"negated":false}]}

description.description: Business-rules documentation for the ruleset (max 2000 chars)

definition.description: The ruleset definition object: {"nodes": [...]} (see tool description for the node schema)

customer_id.description: Customer/user UUID to own the ruleset. Omitted = owned by the API service account

tools.name: mware_pxe_offersiq_update_ruleset

A changed definition creates a new version; by default the new version is activated (set activate_new_version=false to stage it without going live). Backed by PUT /api/pxe/rulesets/{id} and PUT .../versions/{n}/activate (admin-only).

definition.description: New definition object: {"nodes": [...]} (see tool description). Creates a new version

activate_new_version.description: When the definition changed, activate the newly created version (default true)

tools.name: mware_pxe_offersiq_metrics
tools.description: OffersIQ usage metrics for a date range: total requests, live bureau pulls vs cached re-evaluations, failures, and billable counts — as totals plus per-day and per-customer breakdowns. Optionally scoped to one customer. NOT available (backend does not expose/persist them): credit-file hit/no-hit rates and APPROVED/DECLINED decision rates — do not estimate or infer these. Aggregated client-side from GET /api/users/logs/all filtered to the EFX_ONEVIEW_* request-log types, which only OffersIQ produces (admin-only). Large ranges may be truncated — narrow the range if the response says truncated=true.

start_date.description: Start of the range (inclusive), ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

end_date.description: End of the range (inclusive), ISO format YYYY-MM-DD

customer_id.description: Customer/user UUID to scope the metrics to

tools.name: mware_pxe_offersiq_assign_ruleset
tools.description: Wire a ruleset into a customer's product config for OffersIQ decisioning: enable it, disable it (kept but inactive), or remove the entry entirely. Rejects rulesets belonging to other PXE products (only OffersIQ, productId 3, is managed). Returns the config's resulting decisioning-ruleset list plus a cross-config assignment overview. Get the config_id from mware_get_user_config. Backed by PATCH/DELETE /api/users/{id}/config/{configId}/decisioning-rulesets (admin-only).

config_id.description: UUID of the customer's user-config entry (see mware_get_user_config)

action.description: "enable" = add/enable for decisioning; "disable" = keep the entry but inactive; "remove" = delete the entry from the config
